name: Mary-Anne Hartley

affiliations.role: Assistant professor, biomedical informatics and data science

bio: Mary-Anne Hartley is a physician and researcher who leads the LiGHT lab, working across EPFL and Yale School of Medicine, where Hartley is an assistant professor of biomedical informatics and data science. The group builds open medical AI for low-resource settings, including the MEDITRON models, and works with humanitarian organizations such as the ICRC.
known_for: Leads LiGHT lab for global health AI
Open medical AI for low-resource settings
